overal.goal: The hand-written CLI commands bypass `op.execute` and write the stores directly, so they leave no audit line (the generated `boof-runner <area> <verb>` commands, stdio MCP and REST do; see audit-stdio-and-cli-writes). The commands: `run`, `scan`, `project add|list|remove`, `epic add|list|archive|remove`, `task list|move`, `plan import|sync|export`, `auth add|list|revoke|rotate`, `remote setup|status|disable`, `service install|uninstall|status|logs` (`serve` and `mcp` start servers; their calls are audited per request or tool). Either route the writing ones through the operations (so the generated path and its audit line apply) or audit them with the same line shape (`auditOperation` in packages/heart/src/audit-log.ts, `via: cli`, action `cli:<command>`): one line per write, principal (always the local administrator), project, outcome, timing, no arguments. Read-only commands (`list`, `status`, `logs`, `export`) need no line. Decide per command; document the result.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx prettier --check . && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not log request bodies, prompts or keys; the audit log records who, what, outcome and timing only.
Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Filed 2026-11-03 from the audit-stdio-and-cli-writes slice: generated CLI paths are audited, the hand-written commands are not.

tests.strategy: Each writing hand-written command appends one audit line (principal local, action cli:<command>, outcome, ms) and none when security.audit.enabled is false; the line never holds arguments, prompts or keys.
